summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing for iGadget Service Bojonegoro. Backend: 25/25 pytest passing (health, auth cookie+bearer, catalog, estimate, bookings CRUD, ownership/ACL, public tracking, admin stats/status/diagnostic). Frontend: all critical flows verified — landing + sticky mobile CTA (mobile viewport), customer register→/dashboard, admin login→/admin, calculator (smartphone/Apple/iPhone 13/LCD → Rp 1.350.000–1.724.999), 3-step booking wizard→/bookings/:id with timeline visible, dashboard lists own bookings, admin status change (Dikerjakan) persists, diagnostic dialog saves (toast 'Diagnostic report tersimpan'), /track works publicly (no auth), protected routes redirect to /login when logged out.

integration_issues.issue: Login.jsx prioritizes location.state.from over role-based redirect: `const to = location.state?.from || (u.role === 'admin' ? '/admin' : '/dashboard')`. If an unauthenticated user lands on /dashboard (or any protected customer route) and is redirected to /login with state.from set, then logging in AS ADMIN navigates them to that customer route instead of /admin. Recommend: for admin role, force '/admin' regardless of state.from, or only honor state.from if role matches the original route scope.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Adjust admin role-based redirect in /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.jsx so admins always go to /admin even when a prior state.from is set by ProtectedRoute.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS allow_origins is built from FRONTEND_URL + localhost, and allow_credentials=True — correct for cross-site cookie auth. Cookies use secure=True, samesite='none' — required for preview domain, verified working.
server.py: Admin seeding is idempotent and syncs password if it differs — matches playbook requirement.
server.py: Uses bcrypt with $2b$ hash format (default from bcrypt.gensalt) — matches auth playbook.
server.py: All mongo queries use projection {'_id': 0} to exclude ObjectId — no serialization issues observed.
server.py: Single-file (~560 lines) — acceptable but could be modularized into routers/services as it grows.
Frontend api.js uses withCredentials:true AND Bearer fallback from localStorage — robust pattern for cross-site cookie edge cases.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook suggests lockout after 5 fails). Not required by problem statement but flagging for hardening.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@igadget.id / Admin123! (verified). Customers registered dynamically with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded by backend on startup. Test created 2 customer accounts (TEST_cust_*, TEST_other_*, TEST_ui_*) and 2 bookings (1 via UI wizard, 1 via API) for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all 18 endpoints and can be re-run directly: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Admin dashboard uses Indonesian status labels (Diterima/Diagnosa/Dikerjakan/Testing/Siap Diambil/Selesai) — use these when selecting options, not English values. ProtectedRoute sets location.state.from, which causes the admin-redirect quirk described above. Public track page at /track works without auth and doesn't leak user_id/address.
